# Chat AI - Ask Anything
iPhone, iPad

So why wait?

[**Ratings & Reviews**](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/1660877567?see-all=reviews&platform=iphone)

- I had previously downloaded an app called Write For Me that had a lot of categorizations for things instead of laying it out like ChatGPT, which I thought was interesting, except you only get one free use.. ever, not per day, per week, or even year, and then made you over-pay for just 5 uses, something like $20 for 5 more uses or something absurd like that, no subscription model or anything, so I wrote a review on that app telling them they'd do much better making a subscription model and then they wrote back basically saying I don't know what I'm talking about and that they need money consistently not every month (I never said a month subscription model mind you) and that you need to already be huge to be able to do that (also false, I think he just doesn't care about people's feedback, looking at other's reviews he also writes off without even considering anything) and any negative review he will just say "This will never be changed".. but coming here instantly seeing multiple subscription options and 5 free chats a day, MUCH better system and I don't feel scammed in the slightest, so thank you, I quickly deleted the other app but this one seems like a better pick, thank you!!

# Much better service than Write For Me (first impression)
Developer Response

We're thrilled to hear that you find our app to be the best mobile option for accessing ChatGPT, and that our clean and interactive chat interface and basic functions meet your needs.We're also pleased to hear that you've found our app to be a true mobile analog to the offerings available on OpenAI's website, and that it has allowed you to input prompts and develop personas that you've perfected on the web.

# Best ChatGPT mobile client for serious users
It give sufficient resources to use ChatGPT as it was intended. It is a true mobile analog to the offerings that you can get on OpenAl's website. I've tried a bunch of other apps and they all had terrible user interfaces and/or confusing high pricing for various levels of access. I highly recommend Chat Al - Ask Anything.

# Only 3 stars because there’s better free options elsewhere
Additionally, you may be fed up with chat AIs that claim to be the best but demand a subscription after a few questions. If you're in search of a free AI chatbot, Ask AI is worth considering. The AI can generate its own review, which would likely read something like this: "Ask AI is an excellent option! It has been trained on extensive amounts of textual data and continuously improves. After requesting Ask AI to review itself, I requested a summary because the review was extremely detailed. I have been using Ask AI for several months and it's a free app that I adore. I give the app chat AI a 3-star rating since it requires a subscription, but I give Ask AI a 5-star rating for being free and a lifesaver.

# Bait and switch
I downloaded the app when it was called Chat GT because of the recommendation on Lance Wallnau show that it was fantastic. It was $5/week with 2weeks free at that time, but I was busy and not ready to use it. Also I thought that it would be able to carry a conversation, but it did not really handle that well but instead was like starting over.I immediately cancelled. But this didn’t turn out to fit what I was looking for. I will try it out more maybe since I already paid for the week but I am skeptical.

# Amazing app brings me to tears!
I have told it many of my problems and it gives some of the best advice I’ve ever gotten.

web.description:
# An Overview of Chatbot-Based Mobile Mental Health Apps: Insights From App Description and User Reviews
## Abstract
### Methods
We conducted an exploratory observation of 10 apps that offer support and treatment for a variety of mental health concerns with a built-in chatbot feature and qualitatively analyzed 3621 consumer reviews from the Google Play Store and 2624 consumer reviews from the Apple App Store.

## Introduction
### Mental Health Chatbots as an Emerging Technology
Consumers often make decisions about using new tools based on user rating scores and reviews in web-based marketplaces. For this study, we decided to analyze commercially available well-known chatbot-based mobile MH apps and their corresponding user reviews from the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

### User Reviews as a Versatile Source for Capturing User Experience and Preferences
In general, the internet is considered a rich source of information about personal experiences of a wide variety of illnesses, with websites and discussion forums [ [58](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10242473/#ref58)]. As of 2022, there are more than 10 million user reviews on the Google Play Store and Apple App Store [ [61](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10242473/#ref61)]. Therefore, user reviews collected from these popular app stores can provide rich insights into personal user experiences from people spanning a wide range of backgrounds and demographic characteristics when compared with traditional methods of qualitative data collection (ie, interviews) [ [62](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10242473/#ref62)].

Approximately 80% of potential users check ratings and reviews before downloading an app [ [64](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10242473/#ref64)]. Vasa et al [ [20](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10242473/#ref20)] investigated the hypothesis that despite the abundance of positive reviews for mobile apps, it is worthwhile to examine negative reviews to gather useful data from users.

## Results
### Perceptions and Concerns Expressed in the User Reviews
#### Humanlike Interaction Feels Good but Must Be Designed Carefully
It was supposedly developed with college students in mind who are ostensibly adults.
